Deceased husband of Eufemia: 'Famati olim Sarva Fedorowicz Graeci Civis Leopoliensis vidua relicta'.

entities.justification: Son-in-law and appointed guardian of Eufemia: 'per Famatum Theodoricum Litwinski generum suum tutorem sibi ad eum actum assumptum'.
Referred to by the court approving the guardian and maintaining the records: 'ex Officio nostro approbatum' and 'in eisdem actis'.
Locative references appearing throughout the entry: 'Civis Leopoliensis', 'Scabinis Leopoliensibus', 'Civitate Leopoliensi', and 'Actum Leopoli'.
Sum of money paid and remaining: 'de Florenos mille pecuniae Numeri Polonici medietate videlicet maioris summae'.
Total debt mentioned: 'maioris summae Quatuor Millium Florenos debiti sibi'.
